EXTRAORDINARY
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Notification under Section 66c of the Amended Local Government Authorities Elections Ordinance
(Amendment) No. 22 of 2012

I, Mangala Mihilal Wijenayake the Commissioner of Local Government of Uva Province, do hereby notify that the firstmeeting is tendered to nominate Mayors/Chairmen, Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen for the Local Government Institutionsof Uva Province, mentioned in the Schedule below in the date, time in the centres stipulated in the Schedule, by virtue ofpower vested in me under Section 66C of the Amended Local Government Authorities Election Ordinance (Amendment)No. 22 of 2012.
M. M. WIJENAYAKE,Commissioner of Local Govenment
Uva Province.Department of Local Government,Uva Province,Martin Silva Mawatha,Badulla,15th day of March, 2018.
